dashboard.label: Tableau de Bord des Accès Sensibles via Fortigate
dashboard.description: Ce tableau de bord permet de superviser les accès sensibles observés dans les logs Fortigate live, notamment SSH, RDP, SSL/VPN potentiel et SMB. Il met en évidence les volumes d’activité, les actions du pare-feu, les connexions refusées, les activités hors horaires et les sources présentant un comportement potentiellement suspect.

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | eval dstport_str=tostring(dstport) | eval service_lower=lower(coalesce(service,"")) | eval service_sensible=case( dstport_str="22" OR service_lower="ssh","SSH", dstport_str="3389" OR service_lower="rdp","RDP", dstport_str="445" OR service_lower="smb","SMB", service_lower="sslvpn","SSLVPN", 1=1,"Autre" ) | search service_sensible!="Autre" | eval total_bytes=coalesce(tonumber(sentbyte),0)+coalesce(tonumber(rcvdbyte),0) | stats count as evenements dc(srcip) as sources_uniques dc(dstip) as destinations_uniques dc(service_sensible) as services_sensibles sum(total_bytes) as volume_octets | eval volume_Go=round(volume_octets/1024/1024/1024,2) | table evenements sources_uniques destinations_uniques services_sensibles volume_Go

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | eval dstport_str=tostring(dstport) | eval service_lower=lower(coalesce(service,"")) | eval service_sensible=case( dstport_str="22" OR service_lower="ssh","SSH", dstport_str="3389" OR service_lower="rdp","RDP", dstport_str="445" OR service_lower="smb","SMB", service_lower="sslvpn","SSLVPN", 1=1,"Autre" ) | search service_sensible!="Autre" | stats count as evenements by service_sensible | sort - evenements

chart.title: Évolution des accès sensibles dans le temps

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-24h | eval dstport_str=tostring(dstport) | eval service_lower=lower(coalesce(service,"")) | eval service_sensible=case( dstport_str="22" OR service_lower="ssh","SSH", dstport_str="3389" OR service_lower="rdp","RDP", dstport_str="445" OR service_lower="smb","SMB", service_lower="sslvpn","SSLVPN", 1=1,"Autre" ) | search service_sensible!="Autre" | timechart span=1h count by service_sensible

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-24h | eval dstport_str=tostring(dstport) | eval service_lower=lower(coalesce(service,"")) | eval service_sensible=case( dstport_str="22" OR service_lower="ssh","SSH", dstport_str="3389" OR service_lower="rdp","RDP", dstport_str="445" OR service_lower="smb","SMB", service_lower="ssl" OR service_lower="sslvpn","SSL/VPN", 1=1,"Autre" ) | search service_sensible!="Autre" | where action="block" OR action="blocked" | stats count as connexions_bloquees by service_sensible | sort - connexions_bloquees

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | eval dstport_str=tostring(dstport) | eval service_lower=lower(coalesce(service,"")) | eval service_sensible=case(dstport_str="22" OR service_lower="ssh","SSH",dstport_str="3389" OR service_lower="rdp","RDP",dstport_str="445" OR service_lower="smb","SMB",service_lower="sslvpn","SSLVPN",1=1,"Autre") | search service_sensible!="Autre" | eval status=case(action="allowed","autorise",action="block","non_autorise",action="teardown","fin_session",1=1,"autre") | eval heure=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | eval hors_horaires_flag=if(heure<8 OR heure>18,1,0) | bin _time span=15m | stats count(eval(status="autorise")) as autorisees count(eval(status="non_autorise")) as non_autorisees sum(hors_horaires_flag) as hors_horaires dc(dstip) as destinations dc(dstport_str) as ports dc(service_sensible) as services_sensibles by _time srcip | eval decisions=autorisees+non_autorisees | where decisions>0 | eval ratio_non_autorise=round((non_autorisees/decisions)*100,2) | eval score_connexions=case(decisions<20,5,decisions<100,10,decisions<500,15,1=1,20) | eval score_destinations=case(destinations<3,5,destinations<10,10,destinations<30,15,1=1,20) | eval score_ports=case(ports<3,3,ports<10,7,ports<30,12,1=1,15) | eval score_services=case(services_sensibles=1,5,services_sensibles=2,10,services_sensibles>=3,15,1=1,0) | eval score_ratio=case(ratio_non_autorise<50,0,ratio_non_autorise<70,5,ratio_non_autorise<85,10,ratio_non_autorise<95,15,1=1,20) | eval score_horaire=case(hors_horaires=0,0,hors_horaires<10,3,hors_horaires<50,7,1=1,10) | eval score_risque=score_connexions+score_destinations+score_ports+score_services+score_ratio+score_horaire | apply fortigate_sensitive_access_score_model | stats count(eval(IsOutlier=1)) as anomalies_ai

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | eval dstport_str=tostring(dstport) | eval service_lower=lower(coalesce(service,"")) | eval service_sensible=case( dstport_str="22" OR service_lower="ssh","SSH", dstport_str="3389" OR service_lower="rdp","RDP", dstport_str="445" OR service_lower="smb","SMB", service_lower="ssl" OR service_lower="sslvpn","SSL/VPN", 1=1,"Autre" ) | search service_sensible!="Autre" | eval statut_action=case( action="allowed","autorise", action="block" OR action="blocked","non_autorise", action="teardown","fin_session", 1=1,"autre" ) | stats count(eval(statut_action="autorise")) as autorisees count(eval(statut_action="non_autorise")) as non_autorisees count(eval(statut_action="fin_session")) as fins_session dc(dstip) as destinations dc(dstport_str) as ports dc(service_sensible) as services_sensibles values(service_sensible) as services by srcip | eval decisions=autorisees+non_autorisees | where decisions>=50 AND non_autorisees>=25 | eval ratio_non_autorise=round((non_autorisees/decisions)*100,2) | where ratio_non_autorise>=80 | eval categorie_risque=case( ratio_non_autorise>=95 AND non_autorisees>=100 AND destinations>=5,"Critique", ratio_non_autorise>=90 AND non_autorisees>=50,"Élevé", 1=1,"Moyen" ) | sort - non_autorisees | head 50 | table srcip categorie_risque ratio_non_autorise decisions non_autorisees destinations services
